coverage.remaining: Three of the five district nominations of 1982-1989 (87002286, 87002288, 87002289) and the Southern Pacific Company Hospital Historic District (89000319) are fetched and unread.
coverage.note: Liberty Street Historic District (83001230) read whole, including its 51-entry per-building appendix. 30 findings: 29 construction/alteration credits carrying a named architect, builder or contractor, and one dated event — Susan B. Anthony's 1896 suffrage meeting at 159 Liberty Street, a documented public figure's visit and a notable-past-occupant fact under issue #310. 22 of the 51 buildings name no architect, builder or contractor at all (an unknown hand, or only an owner-resident) and were not extracted; the appendix is otherwise dense with owner-residents' names, occupations and tenancy dates, none of them taken.
